excerpt: Compare a JVC studio and one-bedroom apartment using full acquisition cost, tenant fit, owner expenses and net rental income.
introduction:
A Jumeirah Village Circle studio may require less capital than a one-bedroom apartment in a particular comparison, but the lower price does not automatically produce the better investment. Compare real units in similar buildings on the total amount invested, achievable rent, vacancy, service charges and likely resale alternatives.

The calculations below use sample figures to demonstrate the method. Use the worked comparison to see how purchase cost and annual income affect each investment.
takeaways: Compare actual units on the same cost, rent and vacancy assumptions rather than bedroom count alone.
A one-bedroom's extra net income should be considered against the additional capital required.
Check the building's approved service charges, condition, tenant demand and competing supply.

sections.heading: What should the comparison include?
sections.body:
Select a studio and one-bedroom apartment with comparable condition, completion status and access to services. Record usable layout, floor, parking, furnishing, cooling, view and building facilities. A large studio may compete differently from a small one-bedroom; a label alone does not describe the home.

[Property Finder's JVC area guide](https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/area-insights/dubai/jumeirah-village-circle) provides neighbourhood context. Visit the exact building and test routes to the places your intended tenant might use. The [JVC and Arjan comparison](/journal/jvc-vs-arjan-apartment-investment-comparison) explains how to assess the wider location and competing supply.

Seek recent signed leases for similar units in the same building if available, and record their date and terms. An advertised rent is useful context but is not proof of what was agreed or collected.

Confirm whether parking and storage are included, because these features affect how a tenant uses either layout.

sections.heading: Work through a worked example
sections.body:
Assume a studio requires AED 800,000 of total acquisition cost and produces AED 44,000 in annual net operating income after vacancy and owner costs. Its net operating yield is 5.5%. Assume a one-bedroom requires AED 1,100,000 and produces AED 55,000 net, or 5%. Both figures are worked examples before finance, tax and the costs associated with a sale.

The one-bedroom requires AED 300,000 more capital and produces AED 11,000 more annual net income under these assumptions. That incremental income divided by incremental capital is approximately 3.67%. The comparison focuses on annual income after the stated operating costs.

The chart shows the two sample net yields. Change the inputs to reflect the actual apartments and test a longer vacancy or repair.

sections.heading: Check costs and the denominator
sections.body:
Add the purchase price, buyer-paid registration and brokerage, applicable tax on services, initial repairs and furnishing. Request written quotes. A smaller unit can still have meaningful fixed transaction costs, so compare the full capital invested rather than the advertised price alone.

Dubai Land Department's [service charge index](https://dubailand.gov.ae/en/eservices/service-charge-index/) helps check approved community charges. Request the current unit statement, area basis and arrears from management. Add owner-paid management, repairs and insurance, and keep a vacancy allowance.

The [Dubai net rental yield guide](/journal/how-to-calculate-net-rental-yield-in-dubai) shows the formula. Keep mortgage payments and the outstanding loan in a separate cash-flow schedule so the operating comparison remains consistent.

sections.heading: Consider the tenant and the building
sections.body:
Ask whether the layout suits the household likely to rent it: storage, working space, kitchen, privacy and parking can matter as much as the bedroom label. Inspect shared areas and ask about maintenance, access control, lifts and the actual facilities. Check the route to work, transport and daily services at useful times.

Review current competing units and nearby scheduled handovers. A large number of similar apartments may affect the time needed to let, but future vacancy cannot be inferred from a development count alone. Ask how long comparable homes have been offered and seek evidence of signed leases.

If the property is off-plan, verify the project and contract and allow for delivery risk. A future rental estimate is not income until the unit is usable and let.

sections.heading: Test the exit and downside
sections.body:
Look for recent completed sales of similar studios and one-bedroom units where available. Record the dates, condition and terms, and separate completed transactions from asking prices. Include selling charges and any outstanding loan in a future cash estimate.

Test a lower rent, higher service charge and longer vacancy for each unit. The one-bedroom's higher assumed income may or may not compensate for the additional capital; the answer changes with actual price and costs. Keep a reserve for repairs and periods without a tenant.

Assess rental yield alongside selling costs and changes in the property’s value over the holding period. Review your time horizon and ability to absorb a less favourable outcome.

sections.heading: Check financing and the cash reserve
sections.body:
If you intend to borrow, request a written offer for each property showing the loan amount, valuation, rate, fees, insurance and repayment schedule. A bank may assess the two apartments differently, so a comparison based on equal financing assumptions should be updated once actual offers are available. Separate principal and interest and track the remaining balance at a possible sale.

Keep enough cash for payments, repairs and vacancy. Consider whether the larger capital commitment to a one-bedroom leaves sufficient flexibility for other obligations. A higher projected income is useful only if the investor can sustain the property through a less favourable period.

sections.heading: Request current JVC options
sections.body:
Browse the [Aliyas JVC project collection](/projects?emirate=Dubai&area=dubai-jvc) and [contact Aliyas](/contact) with your budget and preferred unit type. Ask which exact apartments are currently available and request their plans, price, service charges and terms.

Verify ownership and official transaction requirements before committing, and replace the example with unit-specific evidence.
